title: Reconciliar estado durable actual de Herramienta audio → texto
mission: Reconcile the durable STT evidence into one current project-state artifact and, only if justified by the evidence, update the portfolio/project status. Separate proven browser transcription capability, warmed-cache behavior, normal study-transcribe handler liveness, unresolved heavy selftest behavior, and the undeployed bounded-probe candidate. Preserve the canonical split between browser/mobile voice capture and authenticated class transcription without claiming private-audio acceptance.
definition_of_done: One durable STT project-state artifact names exact current entrypoints and classifies each capability as PROVEN, BOUNDARY, CANDIDATE_SOURCE_ONLY or UNPROVEN.
Verified browser cold/warm CI evidence and the 2026-09-30 study-transcribe liveness/selftest evidence are consumed without replaying superseded discovery claims.
The undeployed bounded-probe candidate is explicitly separated from served runtime state.
PORTFOLIO/project status is changed only if the evidence supports it; otherwise the artifact records the exact remaining acceptance boundary.
No credential, transcript content, private audio, Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion or external deployment is performed.
